failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite the prior four-week monotonic improvement.

mechanism_narrative: The decision point falls on Ferragosto (Aug 15), the peak of Italian summer out-of-city migration. Depressed WORKPLACES and elevated PARKS reflect residents away from Milan; as the holiday period ends in the following weeks, returning residents should push RETAIL_REC upward as normal urban retail patterns resume.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains flat or declines relative to the last 28 days even as WORKPLACES recovers post-Ferragosto.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next week even though PARKS remains above 10 for the prior two weeks.
